records.issue_text: The database is updated before the external calendar update; if `updateCalendarAttendees` fails, new attendees remain persisted and Cal.com becomes inconsistent with the calendar provider.
records.rationale: The diff shows prisma.booking.update persisting new attendees, then a separate await eventManager.updateCalendarAttendees(evt, booking) with no error handling or transaction — unlike sendAddGuestsEmails, which is wrapped in try/catch. If the calendar call throws, guests remain in the DB while the provider is never updated, producing the exact inconsistency the finding describes. Verifiable directly from the addGuests.handler.ts code.
